items: 🌿Elegant Rattan Design for Versatile Styling - This buffet cabinet features rattan doors that add natural texture and Bohemia modern flair. Perfect as a dining room sideboard, living room console table, kitchen storage cabinet or a cozy coffee bar table, it seamlessly blends into any home decor

🛡️Built to Last with Premium MDF Board - Constructed from high-density, warp-resistant MDF, this rattan cabinet ensures exceptional durability and a smooth, flawless finish. It's designed to withstand daily use while maintaining its elegant appearance for years to come

🔩Adjustable Shelf Storage Cabinet with Customizable Interior - Maximize your space with this sideboard cabinet featuring an easy-to-adjust interior shelf. The movable shelves adapts to fit tall bottles, small appliances, and everyday essentials—making it a highly functional buffet, sideboard, and home storage solution

⚙️Sturdy Buffet Cabinet with 100-lb Weight Capacity - Engineered for unwavering stability, this credenza storage cabinet features robust metal legs and a reinforced central support column that ensures superior weight distribution. With a top surface that safely holds up to 100 lbs, it's perfect as a sturdy TV stand, a reliable kitchen gadget station or a dependable display cabinet for your prized collections

🎁Easy-to-Assemble Furniture & Perfect Gift Idea - Enjoy a truly hassle-free setup with every part clearly labeled and accompanied by intuitive step-by-step instructions. Designed for quick assembly, this is the easiest piece of buffet table you'll ever build—making it a perfect and thoughtful gift for housewarmings, holidays or any special occasion
